kb_predict_size()
Predict size

Predict mean plant weight
kb_predict_biomass_in_situ()
Predict the biomass of in situ surveys
kb_predict_cover_calibration()

Predict biomass over mapped canopy
kb_predict_wetdry()

kb_predict_nitrogen()

Plot predictions with autoplot()

Fit summaries

Describe a fit and summarise its parameters.

kb_model_describe()
Describe a fitted model
tidy(<kb_fit>)
Summaries of the model terms
coef(<kb_fit>)
Coefficients
glance(<kb_fit>)
One-row summary of a fit
summary(<kb_fit>)
Summarise a fit
prior_summary(<kb_fit>)
Priors of a fit
kb_samples() as_draws(<kb_fit>) nchains(<kb_fit>) niterations(<kb_fit>) ndraws(<kb_fit>) nvariables(<kb_fit>) variables(<kb_fit>)
Posterior draws
kb_stancode()
Stan code of a fit

Whether a fit has converged
kb_plot_trace()
Trace plot
pp_check(<kb_fit>)

residuals(<kb_fit>)
Deviance residuals
augment(<kb_fit>)
Add fitted values and residuals to the data
kb_sensitivity()
Prior sensitivity
kb_influence()
Influential observations
loo(<kb_fit>)
Leave-one-out cross-validation
log_lik(<kb_fit>)
Pointwise log-likelihood
